checks.name: KOSPI 200 표기 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (coalesce(cu_base_index, ref_base_index) ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%')

checks.name: KODEX 200 종가
checks.sql: SELECT TRY_CAST(du_clpr AS DOUBLE) FROM kr_etp WHERE pd_itm_no='KR7069500007'

checks.name: TIGER 200 연간 추정 분배금
checks.sql: SELECT TRY_CAST(pd_divd_amt_ann AS DOUBLE) FROM kr_etp WHERE pd_itm_no='KR7102110004'

checks.name: TIGER 200 분배수익률
checks.sql: SELECT TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE) FROM kr_etp WHERE pd_itm_no='KR7102110004'

checks.name: 삼성전자 편입 ETF 총보수 평균(값 보유분)
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)),2) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_listing_status='active' AND drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND pd_itm_no IN (SELECT etf_isin FROM etf_constituent WHERE COMPST_ISU_CD='005930')

checks.name: 미래에셋 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp e LEFT JOIN mgmt_resolved m USING (pd_itm_no) WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) = '미래에셋' OR coalesce(m.resolved, e.cu_fund_mgmt_co) LIKE '미래에셋%')

checks.name: 2027년 만기 AAA 회사채 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) = 1 AND replace(coalesce(MAT_DT,''),'-','') BETWEEN '20270101' AND '20271231'

checks.name: (H) 표기 상장중 ETP 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%(H)%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%(H)%')

checks.name: 위험등급 5~6 ETF 순자산 상위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(drv_risk_grade AS INT) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 거절 사유
terms: 환노출(환헤지 없음) 여부 항목은 원천에 없음

checks.name: 위험등급 1등급 펀드 1년 수익률 상위
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE TRY_CAST(drv_risk_grade AS INT) = 1 AND TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) <> 0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 반도체 표기 ETF 순자산 상위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND pd_nm ILIKE '%반도체%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5
